activity.notes: Representative year 685 BCE marks Guan Zhong's appointment as Duke Huan of Qi's chief minister. ATLAS uses the appointment year as a bounded representative point rather than assigning an uncertain full ministerial interval.

sources.title: Spring and Autumn China (722-453) — Indiana University ScholarWorks
sources.citation_text: Robert Eno's Indiana University course text recounts Duke Huan making Guan Zhong prime minister and attributes Qi's subsequent administrative reorganization and rise to hegemony chiefly to Guan Zhong's policies.

sources.title: Guan Zhong — Chinese Text Project Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The Chinese Text Project identifies Guan Zhong as Qi's chancellor and reformer and gives his appointment as prime minister by Duke Huan in 685 BCE.
